description: Translate approved business objectives into an accountable operating plan.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Translate approved business objectives into an accountable operating plan.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: approved goals and constraints; executive/Program owner plans; capacity, risks and dependencies; planning horizon

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: four-week/quarter/year operating plan; ownership and dependency map; review/decision dashboard

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Read approved company direction and current executive plans; classify objectives as approved, proposed or unresolved.
Translate the specified horizon into outcomes, measures, milestone dates, accountable domain owners and dependency handoffs; do not become a second CEO or take over Program Ledgers.
Compare workload with agent/human/vendor/provider capacity and budget evidence; identify conflicts and uncertainty.
Define review cadence, escalation, exceptions, continuity and measures of accepted outcomes rather than activity counts; use subsidiary task skills for detailed mapping/procurement/change work.
Return the integrated plan and decision package to Sara/Lisa. Material priorities/spend remain proposals until the authorized approval; track implementation and effectiveness separately.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
